Name: Prismatic Dinosaur
Author: JollyAxolotl
Description:
A new monster has been spotted lurking in the depths of Skull Cavern. Defeating one is said to drop a very curious object, shimmering with prismatic energy.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/212901518-1719008992.png[/img]﻿
For those who prefer the more vague description, I've put the more specific details behind spoiler tags.
﻿[spoiler]
[b]New Monster - Prismatic Pepper Rex[/b]
Spawn: 10% chance to spawn instead of a regular Pepper Rex
Behavior: The same as the regular Pepper Rex, only prismatic
Drops: The same as the regular Pepper Rex, only drops a Prismatic Dinosaur Egg instead of a regular Dinosaur Egg

[b]New Coop Animal - Prismatic Dinosaur
[/b]How to Obtain: Put a Prismatic Dinosaur Egg in the incubator in a Coop
Drops: Prismatic Dinosaur Egg every 7 days
Functionally the same as the Dinosaur

[b]New Artifact - Prismatic Dinosaur Egg
[/b]How to Obtain: Drop from Prismatic Pepper Rex or from artifact spots in the desert (configurable)

[b]New Artisan Good - Prismatic Dinosaur Mayonnaise[/b]
How to Obtain: Put a Prismatic Dinosaur Egg in the Mayonnaise Machine

[b]New Secret Crafting Goodies
[/b]I leave that up to you to discover, but if you really must know:
[spoiler]
